questions.stem: A 32-year-old woman presents for a routine ultrasound at 28 weeks of gestation. The obstetrician notes an abnormal S/D ratio in the umbilical artery Doppler assessment. Which of the following implications is most likely associated with this finding?

options.label: A
options.text: Low S/D ratio reflects increased resistance in placental blood flow

options.label: B
options.text: Increased resistance to blood flow in the placenta, indicating potential placental insufficiency

options.label: D
options.text: Indicated fetal distress and warrants delivery
